description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for managing employee pictures in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving ('getOne') and updating ('update') employee pictures via RESTful API calls, utilizing underlying services and models. The class also specifies validation rules and integrates with API documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmployeePictureAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing employee pictures, including retrieval and update operations, validation, and integration with internal services and models.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeePictureService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve an employee's picture by employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' method, ensuring the employee number is accessible.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an employee's picture, including processing base64 content and image metadata.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'update' method, including checks for base64 attachment validity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; raises exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; raises exception if called.
